import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * BusinessService para FRIA - Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment según Art. 27
 *
 * Gestiona evaluaciones de impacto en derechos fundamentales.
 * Usa repositorios JPA en lugar de DAO para mejor integración con Spring Data JPA.
 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class FriaAssessmentBusinessService {

    @Autowired
    private FriaAssessmentRepository repository;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private BpmnWorkflowClient bpmnWorkflowClient;

    /**
     * Crea nueva FRIA
     */
    @Transactional
    public FriaAssessment createFria(Long projectId, Long deployerUserId) {
        log.info("Creating FRIA for project: {}, deployer: {}", projectId, deployerUserId);

        FriaAssessment fria = new FriaAssessment();
        fria.setIdxproject(projectId);
        fria.setIdxuser(deployerUserId);
        fria.setFriaart27compliant(false);
        fria.setFriaapproved(false);
        fria.setFrianotified(false);
        fria.setFriadpiaintegrated(false);
        fria.setFriahitlenabled(false);
        fria.setFriavulnerablegroupsincluded(false);
        fria.setFriacreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        fria.setIduuid(UUID.randomUUID().toString());

        fria = repository.save(fria);
        log.info("FRIA created with ID: {}", fria.getIdxfriaassessment());

        // Disparar workflow BPMN si es necesario
        triggerWorkflowIfNeeded(projectId, fria.getIdxfriaassessment());

        return fria;
    }

    /**
     * Actualiza sección específica de FRIA
     */
    @Transactional
    public void updateFriaSection(Long friaId, String section, Object data) {
        log.info("Updating FRIA section: {} for ID: {}", section, friaId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        // Actualizar sección específica según parámetros
        switch (section) {
            case "PROCESS_DESCRIPTION":
                fria.setFriaprocessdescription((String) data);
                break;
            case "USAGE_PERIOD":
                fria.setFriausageperiod((String) data);
                break;
            case "USAGE_FREQUENCY":
                fria.setFriausagefrequency((String) data);
                break;
            // ... más secciones según necesidad
        }

        fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        repository.save(fria);
    }

    /**
     * Calcula completeness score (0.00 - 1.00)
     * Verifica que los 6 elementos mandatorios Art. 27.1 estén completos
     */
    @Transactional
    public BigDecimal calculateCompletenessScore(Long friaId) {
        log.info("Calculating completeness score for FRIA: {}", friaId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        int completedElements = 0;
        int totalElements = 6; // Art. 27.1 tiene 6 elementos mandatorios

        // Art. 27.1.a - Process description
        if (fria.getFriaprocessdescription() != null && !fria.getFriaprocessdescription().isEmpty()) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.b - Usage period/frequency
        if (fria.getFriausageperiod() != null && fria.getFriausagefrequency() != null) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.c - Affected categories
        if (fria.getFriaaffectedcategories() != null) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.d - Risks
        if (fria.getFriarisks() != null) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.e - Human oversight
        if (fria.getFriahumanoversight() != null && !fria.getFriahumanoversight().isEmpty()) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.f - Mitigation measures
        if (fria.getFriamitigationmeasures() != null && !fria.getFriamitigationmeasures().trim().isEmpty()) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        BigDecimal score = new BigDecimal(completedElements)
            .divide(new BigDecimal(totalElements), 2, BigDecimal.ROUND_HALF_UP);

        fria.setFriacompletenesscore(score);
        fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        repository.save(fria);

        log.info("Completeness score calculated: {} ({}/{})", score, completedElements, totalElements);
        return score;
    }

    /**
     * Envía notificación a autoridad (Art. 27.3)
     */
    @Transactional
    public void submitToAuthority(Long friaId) {
        log.info("Submitting FRIA to authority: {}", friaId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        // Verificar que esté completa
        BigDecimal completenessScore = calculateCompletenessScore(friaId);
        if (completenessScore.compareTo(new BigDecimal("1.00")) < 0) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("FRIA is not complete. Completeness: " + completenessScore);
        }

        // Marcar como notificada
        fria.setFrianotified(true);
        fria.setFrianotificationdate(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        fria.setFrianotificationid(UUID.randomUUID().toString()); // ID temporal, reemplazar con ID real de autoridad
        fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));

        repository.save(fria);
        log.info("FRIA submitted to authority with notification ID: {}", fria.getFrianotificationid());
    }

    /**
     * Integra con DPIA (Art. 27.4)
     */
    @Transactional
    public void integrateWithDpia(Long friaId, String dpiaId) {
        log.info("Integrating FRIA {} with DPIA {}", friaId, dpiaId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        fria.setFriadpiaintegrated(true);
        fria.setFriadpiaid(dpiaId);
        fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));

        repository.save(fria);
        log.info("FRIA integrated with DPIA successfully");
    }

    /**
     * Aprueba FRIA
     */
    @Transactional
    public void approveFria(Long friaId, Long approverUserId) {
        log.info("Approving FRIA {} by user {}", friaId, approverUserId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        fria.setFriaapproved(true);
        fria.setFriaapprovedby(approverUserId);
        fria.setFriaapprovaldate(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));

        repository.save(fria);
        log.info("FRIA approved successfully");
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene FRIAs de un proyecto
     */
    public List<FriaAssessment> getFriasByProject(Long projectId) {
        log.info("Retrieving FRIAs for project: {}", projectId);
        return repository.findByProjectIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(projectId);
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene latest FRIA de proyecto
     */
    public FriaAssessment getLatestFria(Long projectId) {
        log.info("Retrieving latest FRIA for project: {}", projectId);
        List<FriaAssessment> frias = repository.findByProjectIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(projectId);
        return frias.isEmpty() ? null : frias.get(0);
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene FRIA por ID
     */
    public FriaAssessment getFriaById(Long friaId) {
        log.info("Retrieving FRIA by ID: {}", friaId);
        return repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene FRIA por UUID
     */
    public FriaAssessment getFriaByUuid(String uuid) {
        log.info("Retrieving FRIA by UUID: {}", uuid);
        return repository.findByIduuid(uuid)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found with UUID: " + uuid));
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene todas las FRIAs
     */
    public List<FriaAssessment> getAllFrias() {
        log.info("Retrieving all FRIAs");
        return repository.findAllOrderByCreatedAtDesc();
    }

    /**
     * Calcula el riesgo final según Anexo IX del EU AI Act
     *
     * Fórmula: Risk = (Severity × Probability × Impact) × (1 - Mitigation Effectiveness)
     *
     * @param friaId ID de la evaluación FRIA
     * @return Riesgo final calculado (0.0 - 1.0)
     */
    @Transactional
    public BigDecimal calculateFinalRisk(Long friaId) {
        log.info("Calculating final risk for FRIA: {}", friaId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        return calculateFinalRisk(fria);
    }

    /**
     * Calcula el riesgo final a partir de una entidad FRIA
     */
    public BigDecimal calculateFinalRisk(FriaAssessment fria) {
        try {
            // Parsear riesgos y medidas desde JSONB
            List<FriaRiskData> risks = parseRisks(fria.getFriarisks());
            List<MitigationMeasureData> measures = parseMeasures(fria.getFriamitigationmeasures());

            if (risks.isEmpty()) {
                log.warn("No risks found for FRIA: {}", fria.getIdxfriaassessment());
                return BigDecimal.ZERO;
            }

            BigDecimal totalRisk = BigDecimal.ZERO;

            for (FriaRiskData risk : risks) {
                // Calcular riesgo bruto: Severity × Probability × Impact
                BigDecimal severityScore = getSeverityScore(risk.getSeverity());
                BigDecimal impactScore = getImpactScore(risk.getImpact());
                BigDecimal probability = risk.getProbability() != null ?
                    risk.getProbability() : BigDecimal.ZERO;

                BigDecimal rawRisk = severityScore
                    .multiply(probability)
                    .multiply(impactScore);

                // Aplicar efectividad de mitigación
                BigDecimal mitigationEffectiveness = getMitigationEffectiveness(risk.getId(), measures);
                BigDecimal adjustedRisk = rawRisk.multiply(
                    BigDecimal.ONE.subtract(mitigationEffectiveness)
                );

                totalRisk = totalRisk.add(adjustedRisk);
            }

            // Normalizar dividiendo por número de riesgos
            BigDecimal finalRisk = totalRisk.divide(
                new BigDecimal(risks.size()),
                4,
                java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP
            );

            // Guardar riesgo final
            fria.setFriafinalrisk(finalRisk);
            fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
            repository.save(fria);

            log.info("Final risk calculated: {} for FRIA: {}", finalRisk, fria.getIdxfriaassessment());
            return finalRisk;

        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error calculating final risk for FRIA: {}", fria.getIdxfriaassessment(), e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error calculating final risk: " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene score de severidad (LOW=0.25, MEDIUM=0.50, HIGH=0.75, CRITICAL=1.0)
     */
    private BigDecimal getSeverityScore(String severity) {
        if (severity == null) return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);

        switch (severity.toUpperCase()) {
            case "LOW": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
            case "MEDIUM": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50);
            case "HIGH": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.75);
            case "CRITICAL": return BigDecimal.ONE;
            default: return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene score de impacto (Bajo=0.25, Medio=0.50, Alto=0.75)
     */
    private BigDecimal getImpactScore(String impact) {
        if (impact == null) return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);

        switch (impact.toUpperCase()) {
            case "BAJO": case "LOW": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
            case "MEDIO": case "MEDIUM": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50);
            case "ALTO": case "HIGH": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.75);
            default: return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene efectividad de mitigación para un riesgo específico
     */
    private BigDecimal getMitigationEffectiveness(Long riskId, List<MitigationMeasureData> measures) {
        if (measures == null || measures.isEmpty()) {
            return BigDecimal.ZERO;
        }

        BigDecimal maxEffectiveness = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        for (MitigationMeasureData measure : measures) {
            if (measure.getAssociatedRiskId() != null &&
                measure.getAssociatedRiskId().equals(riskId)) {
                BigDecimal effectiveness = measure.getEffectiveness() != null ?
                    measure.getEffectiveness() : BigDecimal.ZERO;
                if (effectiveness.compareTo(maxEffectiveness) > 0) {
                    maxEffectiveness = effectiveness;
                }
            }
        }

        // Limitar a máximo 1.0
        return maxEffectiveness.min(BigDecimal.ONE);
    }

    /**
     * Parsea JSON de riesgos
     */
    private List<FriaRiskData> parseRisks(String risksJson) {
        if (risksJson == null || risksJson.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }

        try {
            com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper mapper = new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper();
            return mapper.readValue(risksJson,
                mapper.getTypeFactory().constructCollectionType(
                    java.util.List.class, FriaRiskData.class));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error parsing risks JSON: {}", risksJson, e);
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Parsea JSON de medidas de mitigación
     */
    private List<MitigationMeasureData> parseMeasures(String measuresJson) {
        if (measuresJson == null || measuresJson.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }

        try {
            com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper mapper = new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper();
            return mapper.readValue(measuresJson,
                mapper.getTypeFactory().constructCollectionType(
                    java.util.List.class, MitigationMeasureData.class));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error parsing mitigation measures JSON: {}", measuresJson, e);
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Clase interna para representar un riesgo FRIA
     */
    public static class FriaRiskData {
        private Long id;
        private String type;
        private String severity;
        private BigDecimal probability;
        private String impact;
        private String description;

        // Getters y setters
        public Long getId() { return id; }
        public void setId(Long id) { this.id = id; }
        public String getType() { return type; }
        public void setType(String type) { this.type = type; }
        public String getSeverity() { return severity; }
        public void setSeverity(String severity) { this.severity = severity; }
        public BigDecimal getProbability() { return probability; }
        public void setProbability(BigDecimal probability) { this.probability = probability; }
        public String getImpact() { return impact; }
        public void setImpact(String impact) { this.impact = impact; }
        public String getDescription() { return description; }
        public void setDescription(String description) { this.description = description; }
    }

    /**
     * Clase interna para representar una medida de mitigación
     */
    public static class MitigationMeasureData {
        private Long id;
        private String description;
        private BigDecimal effectiveness;
        private Long associatedRiskId;
        private String type; // PREVENTIVE, DETECTIVE, CORRECTIVE

        // Getters y setters
        public Long getId() { return id; }
        public void setId(Long id) { this.id = id; }
        public String getDescription() { return description; }
        public void setDescription(String description) { this.description = description; }
        public BigDecimal getEffectiveness() { return effectiveness; }
        public void setEffectiveness(BigDecimal effectiveness) { this.effectiveness = effectiveness; }
        public Long getAssociatedRiskId() { return associatedRiskId; }
        public void setAssociatedRiskId(Long associatedRiskId) { this.associatedRiskId = associatedRiskId; }
        public String getType() { return type; }
        public void setType(String type) { this.type = type; }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN si es necesario
     */
    private void triggerWorkflowIfNeeded(Long projectId, Long friaId) {
        if (bpmnWorkflowClient == null || !bpmnWorkflowClient.isAvailable()) {
            log.warn("BpmnWorkflowClient no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return;
        }

        try {
            // Preparar variables del workflow
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("projectId", projectId);
            variables.put("friaId", friaId);
            variables.put("action", "fria-created");
            variables.put("createdAt", new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()).toString());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN usando el cliente
            String workflowInstanceId = bpmnWorkflowClient.startProcess(
                    "fria-assessment-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Workflow BPMN disparado exitosamente: projectId={}, friaId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        projectId, friaId, workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para FRIA: projectId={}, friaId={}", projectId, friaId, e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar la operación si el workflow falla
        }
    }
}

- Cambios:

  - `dao.update()` → `repository.save()`
  - `dao.findById()` → `repository.findById().orElseThrow()`
  - Queries SQL nativas → métodos del repositorio con JPQL
- Agregado `@Transactional` en métodos que modifican datos
- Agregado soporte para `BpmnWorkflowClient` (inyectado como `@Autowired(required = false)`)
- Agregado método `triggerWorkflowIfNeeded()` para disparar workflows BPMN

- Usa repositorios JPA (no DAO)
- Llamadas a BPMN desde el business service usando `BpmnWorkflowClient`
- Queries con JPQL en lugar de SQL nativo
- Logging con `@Slf4j`
- Manejo de errores con `Optional` y excepciones apropiadas

El servicio ahora sigue la arquitectura definida en el documento: usa repositorios JPA y puede disparar workflows BPMN desde el business service cuando sea necesario.

package com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.FriaAssessment;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.FriaAssessmentRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.client.BpmnWorkflowClient;
import com.codeflowx.governance.client.AIGovernanceClient;
import com.codeflowx.governance.client.model.fria.FriaDataDTO;
import com.codeflowx.governance.client.model.fria.CrossValidationResult;
import com.codeflowx.governance.client.exception.ServiceUnavailableException;
import com.codeflowx.governance.client.exception.AIGovernanceException;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.ArrayList;

/**
 * BusinessService para FRIA - Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment según Art. 27
 *
 * Gestiona evaluaciones de impacto en derechos fundamentales.
 * Usa repositorios JPA en lugar de DAO para mejor integración con Spring Data JPA.
 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class FriaAssessmentBusinessService {

    @Autowired
    private FriaAssessmentRepository repository;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private BpmnWorkflowClient bpmnWorkflowClient;

    /**
     * Crea nueva FRIA
     */
    @Transactional
    public FriaAssessment createFria(Long projectId, Long deployerUserId) {
        log.info("Creating FRIA for project: {}, deployer: {}", projectId, deployerUserId);

        FriaAssessment fria = new FriaAssessment();
        fria.setIdxproject(projectId);
        fria.setIdxuser(deployerUserId);
        fria.setFriaart27compliant(false);
        fria.setFriaapproved(false);
        fria.setFrianotified(false);
        fria.setFriadpiaintegrated(false);
        fria.setFriahitlenabled(false);
        fria.setFriavulnerablegroupsincluded(false);
        fria.setFriacreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        fria.setIduuid(UUID.randomUUID().toString());

        fria = repository.save(fria);
        log.info("FRIA created with ID: {}", fria.getIdxfriaassessment());

        // Disparar workflow BPMN si es necesario
        triggerWorkflowIfNeeded(projectId, fria.getIdxfriaassessment());

        return fria;
    }

    /**
     * Actualiza sección específica de FRIA
     */
    @Transactional
    public void updateFriaSection(Long friaId, String section, Object data) {
        log.info("Updating FRIA section: {} for ID: {}", section, friaId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        // Actualizar sección específica según parámetros
        switch (section) {
            case "PROCESS_DESCRIPTION":
                fria.setFriaprocessdescription((String) data);
                break;
            case "USAGE_PERIOD":
                fria.setFriausageperiod((String) data);
                break;
            case "USAGE_FREQUENCY":
                fria.setFriausagefrequency((String) data);
                break;
            // ... más secciones según necesidad
        }

        fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        repository.save(fria);
    }

    /**
     * Calcula completeness score (0.00 - 1.00)
     * Verifica que los 6 elementos mandatorios Art. 27.1 estén completos
     */
    @Transactional
    public BigDecimal calculateCompletenessScore(Long friaId) {
        log.info("Calculating completeness score for FRIA: {}", friaId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        int completedElements = 0;
        int totalElements = 6; // Art. 27.1 tiene 6 elementos mandatorios

        // Art. 27.1.a - Process description
        if (fria.getFriaprocessdescription() != null && !fria.getFriaprocessdescription().isEmpty()) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.b - Usage period/frequency
        if (fria.getFriausageperiod() != null && fria.getFriausagefrequency() != null) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.c - Affected categories
        if (fria.getFriaaffectedcategories() != null) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.d - Risks
        if (fria.getFriarisks() != null) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.e - Human oversight
        if (fria.getFriahumanoversight() != null && !fria.getFriahumanoversight().isEmpty()) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.f - Mitigation measures
        if (fria.getFriamitigationmeasures() != null && !fria.getFriamitigationmeasures().trim().isEmpty()) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        BigDecimal score = new BigDecimal(completedElements)
            .divide(new BigDecimal(totalElements), 2, BigDecimal.ROUND_HALF_UP);

        fria.setFriacompletenesscore(score);
        fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        repository.save(fria);

        log.info("Completeness score calculated: {} ({}/{})", score, completedElements, totalElements);
        return score;
    }

    /**
     * Envía notificación a autoridad (Art. 27.3)
     */
    @Transactional
    public void submitToAuthority(Long friaId) {
        log.info("Submitting FRIA to authority: {}", friaId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        // Verificar que esté completa
        BigDecimal completenessScore = calculateCompletenessScore(friaId);
        if (completenessScore.compareTo(new BigDecimal("1.00")) < 0) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("FRIA is not complete. Completeness: " + completenessScore);
        }

        // Marcar como notificada
        fria.setFrianotified(true);
        fria.setFrianotificationdate(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        fria.setFrianotificationid(UUID.randomUUID().toString()); // ID temporal, reemplazar con ID real de autoridad
        fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));

        repository.save(fria);
        log.info("FRIA submitted to authority with notification ID: {}", fria.getFrianotificationid());
    }

    /**
     * Integra con DPIA (Art. 27.4)
     */
    @Transactional
    public void integrateWithDpia(Long friaId, String dpiaId) {
        log.info("Integrating FRIA {} with DPIA {}", friaId, dpiaId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        fria.setFriadpiaintegrated(true);
        fria.setFriadpiaid(dpiaId);
        fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));

        repository.save(fria);
        log.info("FRIA integrated with DPIA successfully");
    }

    /**
     * Aprueba FRIA
     */
    @Transactional
    public void approveFria(Long friaId, Long approverUserId) {
        log.info("Approving FRIA {} by user {}", friaId, approverUserId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        fria.setFriaapproved(true);
        fria.setFriaapprovedby(approverUserId);
        fria.setFriaapprovaldate(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));

        repository.save(fria);
        log.info("FRIA approved successfully");
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene FRIAs de un proyecto
     */
    public List<FriaAssessment> getFriasByProject(Long projectId) {
        log.info("Retrieving FRIAs for project: {}", projectId);
        return repository.findByProjectIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(projectId);
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene latest FRIA de proyecto
     */
    public FriaAssessment getLatestFria(Long projectId) {
        log.info("Retrieving latest FRIA for project: {}", projectId);
        List<FriaAssessment> frias = repository.findByProjectIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(projectId);
        return frias.isEmpty() ? null : frias.get(0);
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene FRIA por ID
     */
    public FriaAssessment getFriaById(Long friaId) {
        log.info("Retrieving FRIA by ID: {}", friaId);
        return repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene FRIA por UUID
     */
    public FriaAssessment getFriaByUuid(String uuid) {
        log.info("Retrieving FRIA by UUID: {}", uuid);
        return repository.findByIduuid(uuid)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found with UUID: " + uuid));
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene todas las FRIAs
     */
    public List<FriaAssessment> getAllFrias() {
        log.info("Retrieving all FRIAs");
        return repository.findAllOrderByCreatedAtDesc();
    }

    /**
     * Calcula el riesgo final según Anexo IX del EU AI Act
     *
     * Fórmula: Risk = (Severity × Probability × Impact) × (1 - Mitigation Effectiveness)
     *
     * @param friaId ID de la evaluación FRIA
     * @return Riesgo final calculado (0.0 - 1.0)
     */
    @Transactional
    public BigDecimal calculateFinalRisk(Long friaId) {
        log.info("Calculating final risk for FRIA: {}", friaId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        return calculateFinalRisk(fria);
    }

    /**
     * Calcula el riesgo final a partir de una entidad FRIA
     */
    public BigDecimal calculateFinalRisk(FriaAssessment fria) {
        try {
            // Parsear riesgos y medidas desde JSONB
            List<FriaRiskData> risks = parseRisks(fria.getFriarisks());
            List<MitigationMeasureData> measures = parseMeasures(fria.getFriamitigationmeasures());

            if (risks.isEmpty()) {
                log.warn("No risks found for FRIA: {}", fria.getIdxfriaassessment());
                return BigDecimal.ZERO;
            }

            BigDecimal totalRisk = BigDecimal.ZERO;

            for (FriaRiskData risk : risks) {
                // Calcular riesgo bruto: Severity × Probability × Impact
                BigDecimal severityScore = getSeverityScore(risk.getSeverity());
                BigDecimal impactScore = getImpactScore(risk.getImpact());
                BigDecimal probability = risk.getProbability() != null ?
                    risk.getProbability() : BigDecimal.ZERO;

                BigDecimal rawRisk = severityScore
                    .multiply(probability)
                    .multiply(impactScore);

                // Aplicar efectividad de mitigación
                BigDecimal mitigationEffectiveness = getMitigationEffectiveness(risk.getId(), measures);
                BigDecimal adjustedRisk = rawRisk.multiply(
                    BigDecimal.ONE.subtract(mitigationEffectiveness)
                );

                totalRisk = totalRisk.add(adjustedRisk);
            }

            // Normalizar dividiendo por número de riesgos
            BigDecimal finalRisk = totalRisk.divide(
                new BigDecimal(risks.size()),
                4,
                java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP
            );

            // Guardar riesgo final
            fria.setFriafinalrisk(finalRisk);
            fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
            repository.save(fria);

            log.info("Final risk calculated: {} for FRIA: {}", finalRisk, fria.getIdxfriaassessment());
            return finalRisk;

        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error calculating final risk for FRIA: {}", fria.getIdxfriaassessment(), e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error calculating final risk: " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene score de severidad (LOW=0.25, MEDIUM=0.50, HIGH=0.75, CRITICAL=1.0)
     */
    private BigDecimal getSeverityScore(String severity) {
        if (severity == null) return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);

        switch (severity.toUpperCase()) {
            case "LOW": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
            case "MEDIUM": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50);
            case "HIGH": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.75);
            case "CRITICAL": return BigDecimal.ONE;
            default: return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene score de impacto (Bajo=0.25, Medio=0.50, Alto=0.75)
     */
    private BigDecimal getImpactScore(String impact) {
        if (impact == null) return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);

        switch (impact.toUpperCase()) {
            case "BAJO": case "LOW": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
            case "MEDIO": case "MEDIUM": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50);
            case "ALTO": case "HIGH": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.75);
            default: return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene efectividad de mitigación para un riesgo específico
     */
    private BigDecimal getMitigationEffectiveness(Long riskId, List<MitigationMeasureData> measures) {
        if (measures == null || measures.isEmpty()) {
            return BigDecimal.ZERO;
        }

        BigDecimal maxEffectiveness = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        for (MitigationMeasureData measure : measures) {
            if (measure.getAssociatedRiskId() != null &&
                measure.getAssociatedRiskId().equals(riskId)) {
                BigDecimal effectiveness = measure.getEffectiveness() != null ?
                    measure.getEffectiveness() : BigDecimal.ZERO;
                if (effectiveness.compareTo(maxEffectiveness) > 0) {
                    maxEffectiveness = effectiveness;
                }
            }
        }

        // Limitar a máximo 1.0
        return maxEffectiveness.min(BigDecimal.ONE);
    }

    /**
     * Parsea JSON de riesgos
     */
    private List<FriaRiskData> parseRisks(String risksJson) {
        if (risksJson == null || risksJson.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }

        try {
            com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper mapper = new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper();
            return mapper.readValue(risksJson,
                mapper.getTypeFactory().constructCollectionType(
                    java.util.List.class, FriaRiskData.class));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error parsing risks JSON: {}", risksJson, e);
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Parsea JSON de medidas de mitigación
     */
    private List<MitigationMeasureData> parseMeasures(String measuresJson) {
        if (measuresJson == null || measuresJson.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }

        try {
            com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper mapper = new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper();
            return mapper.readValue(measuresJson,
                mapper.getTypeFactory().constructCollectionType(
                    java.util.List.class, MitigationMeasureData.class));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error parsing mitigation measures JSON: {}", measuresJson, e);
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Clase interna para representar un riesgo FRIA
     */
    public static class FriaRiskData {
        private Long id;
        private String type;
        private String severity;
        private BigDecimal probability;
        private String impact;
        private String description;

        // Getters y setters
        public Long getId() { return id; }
        public void setId(Long id) { this.id = id; }
        public String getType() { return type; }
        public void setType(String type) { this.type = type; }
        public String getSeverity() { return severity; }
        public void setSeverity(String severity) { this.severity = severity; }
        public BigDecimal getProbability() { return probability; }
        public void setProbability(BigDecimal probability) { this.probability = probability; }
        public String getImpact() { return impact; }
        public void setImpact(String impact) { this.impact = impact; }
        public String getDescription() { return description; }
        public void setDescription(String description) { this.description = description; }
    }

    /**
     * Clase interna para representar una medida de mitigación
     */
    public static class MitigationMeasureData {
        private Long id;
        private String description;
        private BigDecimal effectiveness;
        private Long associatedRiskId;
        private String type; // PREVENTIVE, DETECTIVE, CORRECTIVE

        // Getters y setters
        public Long getId() { return id; }
        public void setId(Long id) { this.id = id; }
        public String getDescription() { return description; }
        public void setDescription(String description) { this.description = description; }
        public BigDecimal getEffectiveness() { return effectiveness; }
        public void setEffectiveness(BigDecimal effectiveness) { this.effectiveness = effectiveness; }
        public Long getAssociatedRiskId() { return associatedRiskId; }
        public void setAssociatedRiskId(Long associatedRiskId) { this.associatedRiskId = associatedRiskId; }
        public String getType() { return type; }
        public void setType(String type) { this.type = type; }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN si es necesario
     */
    private void triggerWorkflowIfNeeded(Long projectId, Long friaId) {
        if (bpmnWorkflowClient == null || !bpmnWorkflowClient.isAvailable()) {
            log.warn("BpmnWorkflowClient no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return;
        }

        try {
            // Preparar variables del workflow
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("projectId", projectId);
            variables.put("friaId", friaId);
            variables.put("action", "fria-created");
            variables.put("createdAt", new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()).toString());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN usando el cliente
            String workflowInstanceId = bpmnWorkflowClient.startProcess(
                    "fria-assessment-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Workflow BPMN disparado exitosamente: projectId={}, friaId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        projectId, friaId, workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para FRIA: projectId={}, friaId={}", projectId, friaId, e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar la operación si el workflow falla
        }
    }
}

        // Art. 27.1.b - Usage period/frequency
        if (fria.getFriausageperiod() != null && fria.getFriausagefrequency() != null) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.c - Affected categories
        if (fria.getFriaaffectedcategories() != null) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.d - Risks
        if (fria.getFriarisks() != null) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.e - Human oversight
        if (fria.getFriahumanoversight() != null && !fria.getFriahumanoversight().isEmpty()) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        // Art. 27.1.f - Mitigation measures
        if (fria.getFriamitigationmeasures() != null && !fria.getFriamitigationmeasures().trim().isEmpty()) {
            completedElements++;
        }

        BigDecimal score = new BigDecimal(completedElements)
            .divide(new BigDecimal(totalElements), 2, BigDecimal.ROUND_HALF_UP);

        fria.setFriacompletenesscore(score);
        fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
        repository.save(fria);

        log.info("Completeness score calculated: {} ({}/{})", score, completedElements, totalElements);
        return score;
    }

    /**
     * Calcula el riesgo final según Anexo IX del EU AI Act
     *
     * Fórmula: Risk = (Severity × Probability × Impact) × (1 - Mitigation Effectiveness)
     *
     * @param friaId ID de la evaluación FRIA
     * @return Riesgo final calculado (0.0 - 1.0)
     */
    @Transactional
    public BigDecimal calculateFinalRisk(Long friaId) {
        log.info("Calculating final risk for FRIA: {}", friaId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        return calculateFinalRisk(fria);
    }

    /**
     * Calcula el riesgo final a partir de una entidad FRIA
     */
    public BigDecimal calculateFinalRisk(FriaAssessment fria) {
        try {
            // Parsear riesgos y medidas desde JSONB
            List<FriaRiskData> risks = parseRisks(fria.getFriarisks());
            List<MitigationMeasureData> measures = parseMeasures(fria.getFriamitigationmeasures());

            if (risks.isEmpty()) {
                log.warn("No risks found for FRIA: {}", fria.getIdxfriaassessment());
                return BigDecimal.ZERO;
            }

            BigDecimal totalRisk = BigDecimal.ZERO;

            for (FriaRiskData risk : risks) {
                // Calcular riesgo bruto: Severity × Probability × Impact
                BigDecimal severityScore = getSeverityScore(risk.getSeverity());
                BigDecimal impactScore = getImpactScore(risk.getImpact());
                BigDecimal probability = risk.getProbability() != null ?
                    risk.getProbability() : BigDecimal.ZERO;

                BigDecimal rawRisk = severityScore
                    .multiply(probability)
                    .multiply(impactScore);

                // Aplicar efectividad de mitigación
                BigDecimal mitigationEffectiveness = getMitigationEffectiveness(risk.getId(), measures);
                BigDecimal adjustedRisk = rawRisk.multiply(
                    BigDecimal.ONE.subtract(mitigationEffectiveness)
                );

                totalRisk = totalRisk.add(adjustedRisk);
            }

            // Normalizar dividiendo por número de riesgos
            BigDecimal finalRisk = totalRisk.divide(
                new BigDecimal(risks.size()),
                4,
                java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP
            );

            // Guardar riesgo final
            fria.setFriafinalrisk(finalRisk);
            fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
            repository.save(fria);

            log.info("Final risk calculated: {} for FRIA: {}", finalRisk, fria.getIdxfriaassessment());
            return finalRisk;

        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error calculating final risk for FRIA: {}", fria.getIdxfriaassessment(), e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error calculating final risk: " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene score de severidad (LOW=0.25, MEDIUM=0.50, HIGH=0.75, CRITICAL=1.0)
     */
    private BigDecimal getSeverityScore(String severity) {
        if (severity == null) return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);

        switch (severity.toUpperCase()) {
            case "LOW": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
            case "MEDIUM": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50);
            case "HIGH": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.75);
            case "CRITICAL": return BigDecimal.ONE;
            default: return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene score de impacto (Bajo=0.25, Medio=0.50, Alto=0.75)
     */
    private BigDecimal getImpactScore(String impact) {
        if (impact == null) return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);

        switch (impact.toUpperCase()) {
            case "BAJO": case "LOW": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
            case "MEDIO": case "MEDIUM": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50);
            case "ALTO": case "HIGH": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.75);
            default: return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene efectividad de mitigación para un riesgo específico
     */
    private BigDecimal getMitigationEffectiveness(Long riskId, List<MitigationMeasureData> measures) {
        if (measures == null || measures.isEmpty()) {
            return BigDecimal.ZERO;
        }

        BigDecimal maxEffectiveness = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        for (MitigationMeasureData measure : measures) {
            if (measure.getAssociatedRiskId() != null &&
                measure.getAssociatedRiskId().equals(riskId)) {
                BigDecimal effectiveness = measure.getEffectiveness() != null ?
                    measure.getEffectiveness() : BigDecimal.ZERO;
                if (effectiveness.compareTo(maxEffectiveness) > 0) {
                    maxEffectiveness = effectiveness;
                }
            }
        }

        // Limitar a máximo 1.0
        return maxEffectiveness.min(BigDecimal.ONE);
    }

    /**
     * Parsea JSON de riesgos
     */
    private List<FriaRiskData> parseRisks(String risksJson) {
        if (risksJson == null || risksJson.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }

        try {
            com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper mapper = new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper();
            return mapper.readValue(risksJson,
                mapper.getTypeFactory().constructCollectionType(
                    java.util.List.class, FriaRiskData.class));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error parsing risks JSON: {}", risksJson, e);
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Parsea JSON de medidas de mitigación
     */
    private List<MitigationMeasureData> parseMeasures(String measuresJson) {
        if (measuresJson == null || measuresJson.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }

        try {
            com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper mapper = new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper();
            return mapper.readValue(measuresJson,
                mapper.getTypeFactory().constructCollectionType(
                    java.util.List.class, MitigationMeasureData.class));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error parsing mitigation measures JSON: {}", measuresJson, e);
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Clase interna para representar un riesgo FRIA
     */
    public static class FriaRiskData {
        private Long id;
        private String type;
        private String severity;
        private BigDecimal probability;
        private String impact;
        private String description;

        // Getters y setters
        public Long getId() { return id; }
        public void setId(Long id) { this.id = id; }
        public String getType() { return type; }
        public void setType(String type) { this.type = type; }
        public String getSeverity() { return severity; }
        public void setSeverity(String severity) { this.severity = severity; }
        public BigDecimal getProbability() { return probability; }
        public void setProbability(BigDecimal probability) { this.probability = probability; }
        public String getImpact() { return impact; }
        public void setImpact(String impact) { this.impact = impact; }
        public String getDescription() { return description; }
        public void setDescription(String description) { this.description = description; }
    }

    /**
     * Clase interna para representar una medida de mitigación
     */
    public static class MitigationMeasureData {
        private Long id;
        private String description;
        private BigDecimal effectiveness;
        private Long associatedRiskId;
        private String type; // PREVENTIVE, DETECTIVE, CORRECTIVE

        // Getters y setters
        public Long getId() { return id; }
        public void setId(Long id) { this.id = id; }
        public String getDescription() { return description; }
        public void setDescription(String description) { this.description = description; }
        public BigDecimal getEffectiveness() { return effectiveness; }
        public void setEffectiveness(BigDecimal effectiveness) { this.effectiveness = effectiveness; }
        public Long getAssociatedRiskId() { return associatedRiskId; }
        public void setAssociatedRiskId(Long associatedRiskId) { this.associatedRiskId = associatedRiskId; }
        public String getType() { return type; }
        public void setType(String type) { this.type = type; }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN si es necesario
     */
    private void triggerWorkflowIfNeeded(Long projectId, Long friaId) {
        if (bpmnWorkflowClient == null || !bpmnWorkflowClient.isAvailable()) {
            log.warn("BpmnWorkflowClient no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return;
        }

        try {
            // Preparar variables del workflow
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("projectId", projectId);
            variables.put("friaId", friaId);
            variables.put("action", "fria-created");
            variables.put("createdAt", new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()).toString());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN usando el cliente
            String workflowInstanceId = bpmnWorkflowClient.startProcess(
                    "fria-assessment-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Workflow BPMN disparado exitosamente: projectId={}, friaId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        projectId, friaId, workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para FRIA: projectId={}, friaId={}", projectId, friaId, e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar la operación si el workflow falla
        }
    }
}

                BigDecimal adjustedRisk = rawRisk.multiply(
                    BigDecimal.ONE.subtract(mitigationEffectiveness)
                );

                totalRisk = totalRisk.add(adjustedRisk);
            }

            // Normalizar dividiendo por número de riesgos
            BigDecimal finalRisk = totalRisk.divide(
                new BigDecimal(risks.size()),
                4,
                java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP
            );

            // Guardar riesgo final
            fria.setFriafinalrisk(finalRisk);
            fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
            repository.save(fria);

            log.info("Final risk calculated: {} for FRIA: {}", finalRisk, fria.getIdxfriaassessment());
            return finalRisk;

        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error calculating final risk for FRIA: {}", fria.getIdxfriaassessment(), e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error calculating final risk: " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene score de severidad (LOW=0.25, MEDIUM=0.50, HIGH=0.75, CRITICAL=1.0)
     */
    private BigDecimal getSeverityScore(String severity) {
        if (severity == null) return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);

        switch (severity.toUpperCase()) {
            case "LOW": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
            case "MEDIUM": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50);
            case "HIGH": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.75);
            case "CRITICAL": return BigDecimal.ONE;
            default: return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene score de impacto (Bajo=0.25, Medio=0.50, Alto=0.75)
     */
    private BigDecimal getImpactScore(String impact) {
        if (impact == null) return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);

        switch (impact.toUpperCase()) {
            case "BAJO": case "LOW": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
            case "MEDIO": case "MEDIUM": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50);
            case "ALTO": case "HIGH": return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.75);
            default: return BigDecimal.valueOf(0.25);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene efectividad de mitigación para un riesgo específico
     */
    private BigDecimal getMitigationEffectiveness(Long riskId, List<MitigationMeasureData> measures) {
        if (measures == null || measures.isEmpty()) {
            return BigDecimal.ZERO;
        }

        BigDecimal maxEffectiveness = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        for (MitigationMeasureData measure : measures) {
            if (measure.getAssociatedRiskId() != null &&
                measure.getAssociatedRiskId().equals(riskId)) {
                BigDecimal effectiveness = measure.getEffectiveness() != null ?
                    measure.getEffectiveness() : BigDecimal.ZERO;
                if (effectiveness.compareTo(maxEffectiveness) > 0) {
                    maxEffectiveness = effectiveness;
                }
            }
        }

        // Limitar a máximo 1.0
        return maxEffectiveness.min(BigDecimal.ONE);
    }

    /**
     * Parsea JSON de riesgos
     */
    private List<FriaRiskData> parseRisks(String risksJson) {
        if (risksJson == null || risksJson.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }

        try {
            com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper mapper = new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper();
            return mapper.readValue(risksJson,
                mapper.getTypeFactory().constructCollectionType(
                    java.util.List.class, FriaRiskData.class));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error parsing risks JSON: {}", risksJson, e);
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Parsea JSON de medidas de mitigación
     */
    private List<MitigationMeasureData> parseMeasures(String measuresJson) {
        if (measuresJson == null || measuresJson.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }

        try {
            com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper mapper = new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper();
            return mapper.readValue(measuresJson,
                mapper.getTypeFactory().constructCollectionType(
                    java.util.List.class, MitigationMeasureData.class));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error parsing mitigation measures JSON: {}", measuresJson, e);
            return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Clase interna para representar un riesgo FRIA
     */
    public static class FriaRiskData {
        private Long id;
        private String type;
        private String severity;
        private BigDecimal probability;
        private String impact;
        private String description;

        // Getters y setters
        public Long getId() { return id; }
        public void setId(Long id) { this.id = id; }
        public String getType() { return type; }
        public void setType(String type) { this.type = type; }
        public String getSeverity() { return severity; }
        public void setSeverity(String severity) { this.severity = severity; }
        public BigDecimal getProbability() { return probability; }
        public void setProbability(BigDecimal probability) { this.probability = probability; }
        public String getImpact() { return impact; }
        public void setImpact(String impact) { this.impact = impact; }
        public String getDescription() { return description; }
        public void setDescription(String description) { this.description = description; }
    }

    /**
     * Clase interna para representar una medida de mitigación
     */
    public static class MitigationMeasureData {
        private Long id;
        private String description;
        private BigDecimal effectiveness;
        private Long associatedRiskId;
        private String type; // PREVENTIVE, DETECTIVE, CORRECTIVE

        // Getters y setters
        public Long getId() { return id; }
        public void setId(Long id) { this.id = id; }
        public String getDescription() { return description; }
        public void setDescription(String description) { this.description = description; }
        public BigDecimal getEffectiveness() { return effectiveness; }
        public void setEffectiveness(BigDecimal effectiveness) { this.effectiveness = effectiveness; }
        public Long getAssociatedRiskId() { return associatedRiskId; }
        public void setAssociatedRiskId(Long associatedRiskId) { this.associatedRiskId = associatedRiskId; }
        public String getType() { return type; }
        public void setType(String type) { this.type = type; }
    }

    /**
     * Valida consistencia entre FRIA documental y métricas técnicas usando microservicio Python
     *
     * @param friaId ID de la evaluación FRIA
     * @return Resultado de validación cruzada
     */
    @Transactional
    public CrossValidationResult crossValidate(Long friaId) {
        log.info("Cross-validating FRIA with technical metrics: {}", friaId);

        FriaAssessment fria = repository.findById(friaId)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("FRIA not found: " + friaId));

        // Verificar si el cliente de Python está disponible
        if (aiGovernanceClient == null) {
            log.warn("AIGovernanceClient no está disponible. Cross-validation no se realizará.");
            throw new IllegalStateException("Servicio de validación cruzada no disponible temporalmente");
        }

        try {
            // Convertir entidad FRIA a FriaDataDTO
            FriaDataDTO friaData = convertToFriaDataDTO(fria);

            // Llamar microservicio Python para validación cruzada
            CrossValidationResult result = aiGovernanceClient
                .friaGenerator()
                .crossValidate(friaData);

            // Persistir resultado en la entidad
            if (result != null) {
                // Convertir resultado a JSON y guardarlo
                String resultJson = objectMapper.writeValueAsString(result);
                fria.setFriacrossvalidationresult(resultJson);
                fria.setFriaupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
                repository.save(fria);

                log.info("Cross-validation completed: consistencyScore={}, isConsistent={}",
                    result.getConsistencyScore(), result.getIsConsistent());
            }

            return result;

        } catch (ServiceUnavailableException e) {
            log.error("Microservicio de Python no disponible para cross-validation", e);
            throw new IllegalStateException("Servicio de validación cruzada no disponible temporalmente");
        } catch (AIGovernanceException e) {
            log.error("Error en microservicio de Python para cross-validation: service={}, status={}",
                e.getService(), e.getStatusCode(), e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error al validar FRIA: " + e.getMessage());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error inesperado en cross-validation para FRIA: {}", friaId, e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error al validar FRIA: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Convierte entidad FriaAssessment a FriaDataDTO para el cliente de Python
     */
    private FriaDataDTO convertToFriaDataDTO(FriaAssessment fria) {
        try {
            // Parsear riesgos y medidas desde JSONB
            List<FriaRiskData> risks = parseRisks(fria.getFriarisks());
            List<MitigationMeasureData> measures = parseMeasures(fria.getFriamitigationmeasures());

            // Convertir riesgos a formato esperado por el cliente
            List<Map<String, Object>> declaredRisks = new ArrayList<>();
            for (FriaRiskData risk : risks) {
                Map<String, Object> riskMap = new HashMap<>();
                riskMap.put("riskId", risk.getId() != null ? "RISK-" + risk.getId() : UUID.randomUUID().toString());
                riskMap.put("description", risk.getDescription());
                riskMap.put("severity", risk.getSeverity());
                riskMap.put("probability", risk.getProbability() != null ? risk.getProbability().doubleValue() : 0.0);
                riskMap.put("impact", risk.getImpact());
                riskMap.put("type", risk.getType());
                declaredRisks.add(riskMap);
            }

            // Convertir medidas de mitigación a formato esperado por el cliente
            List<Map<String, Object>> declaredMitigations = new ArrayList<>();
            for (MitigationMeasureData measure : measures) {
                Map<String, Object> measureMap = new HashMap<>();
                measureMap.put("measureId", measure.getId() != null ? "MIT-" + measure.getId() : UUID.randomUUID().toString());
                measureMap.put("type", measure.getType());
                measureMap.put("description", measure.getDescription());
                measureMap.put("effectiveness", measure.getEffectiveness() != null ? measure.getEffectiveness().doubleValue() : 0.0);
                if (measure.getAssociatedRiskId() != null) {
                    measureMap.put("associatedRiskId", "RISK-" + measure.getAssociatedRiskId());
                }
                declaredMitigations.add(measureMap);
            }

            // Construir FriaDataDTO
            return FriaDataDTO.builder()
                .projectId(fria.getIdxproject() != null ? fria.getIdxproject().intValue() : null)
                .modelId(null) // TODO: Obtener modelId si está disponible en la entidad
                .datasetId(null) // TODO: Obtener datasetId si está disponible en la entidad
                .declaredRisks(declaredRisks)
                .declaredMitigations(declaredMitigations)
                .build();

        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error convirtiendo FriaAssessment a FriaDataDTO: {}", fria.getIdxfriaassessment(), e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error al preparar datos para validación cruzada: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN si es necesario
     */
    private void triggerWorkflowIfNeeded(Long projectId, Long friaId) {
        if (bpmnWorkflowClient == null || !bpmnWorkflowClient.isAvailable()) {
            log.warn("BpmnWorkflowClient no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return;
        }

        try {
            // Preparar variables del workflow
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("projectId", projectId);
            variables.put("friaId", friaId);
            variables.put("action", "fria-created");
            variables.put("createdAt", new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()).toString());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN usando el cliente
            String workflowInstanceId = bpmnWorkflowClient.startProcess(
                    "fria-assessment-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Workflow BPMN disparado exitosamente: projectId={}, friaId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        projectId, friaId, workflowInstanceId);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para FRIA: projectId={}, friaId={}", projectId, friaId, e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar la operación si el workflow falla
        }
    }
}

Integración completada. Resumen de cambios:

## Integración con microservicios de Python

### Cambios realizados

1. Agregado `AIGovernanceClient` al `FriaAssessmentBusinessService`:
   - Inyectado como `@Autowired(required = false)` (opcional)
   - Cliente principal que actúa como factoría para acceder a clientes especializados

2. Implementado método `crossValidate()`:
   - Obtiene la entidad `FriaAssessment` desde el repositorio
   - Convierte los datos a `FriaDataDTO` usando el método `convertToFriaDataDTO()`
   - Llama al microservicio Python usando `aiGovernanceClient.friaGenerator().crossValidate()`
   - Persiste el resultado en el campo `friacrossvalidationresult` de la entidad
   - Maneja excepciones (`ServiceUnavailableException`, `AIGovernanceException`)

3. Implementado método `convertToFriaDataDTO()`:
   - Convierte la entidad `FriaAssessment` a `FriaDataDTO`
   - Parsea riesgos y medidas de mitigación desde JSONB
   - Mapea los datos al formato esperado por el cliente de Python

### Cumplimiento con arquitectura

- Usa clientes del módulo `codeflowx.govern.nocode.client`
- Llamadas desde el servicio de negocio (no desde el BFF)
- Manejo de errores con excepciones específicas
- Logging para debugging
- Persistencia de resultados en PostgreSQL vía JPA
- Dependencia ya configurada en `pom.xml`

### Uso

El método `crossValidate(Long friaId)` puede ser llamado desde:
- El microservicio de FRIA (`codeflowx-governance-fria-service`)
- El BFF (que a su vez llama al microservicio)
- Cualquier otro servicio de negocio que necesite validar un FRIA

El servicio está listo para integrarse con el microservicio Python `leka-fria-generator` cuando esté disponible.

package com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.controller;

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;

import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.FriaAssessmentDto;

import io.micrometer.core.annotation.Timed;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;

import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

/**
 * Controller reactivo para FRIA (Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment).
 *
 * Este controller actúa como BFF, agregando datos de múltiples microservicios
 * y proporcionando endpoints optimizados para el frontend.
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - POST /api/v1/fria/create - Crear nueva evaluación FRIA
 * - PUT /api/v1/fria/{friaId}/step/{stepNumber} - Actualizar paso del wizard
 * - POST /api/v1/fria/{friaId}/calculate-risk - Calcular riesgo final
 * - POST /api/v1/fria/{friaId}/notify-authority - Notificar a autoridades
 * - POST /api/v1/fria/{friaId}/cross-validate - Validación cruzada con métricas técnicas

 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/fria")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Tag(name = "FRIA", description = "Evaluación de Impacto en Derechos Fundamentales (Art. 27 EU AI Act)")
@Timed(value = "compliance.fria.controller", description = "Métricas del controller FRIA")
public class FriaController {

    private final FriaService friaService;
    private final ComplianceMetrics metrics;

    @PostMapping("/create")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Crear nueva evaluación FRIA",
            description = "Crea una nueva evaluación FRIA para un proyecto. " +
                         "Este endpoint valida el proyecto y crea la evaluación inicial."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Evaluación FRIA creada exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = FriaAssessmentDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido o proyecto no encontrado"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    @Timed(value = "compliance.fria.create", description = "Tiempo de creación de FRIA")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<FriaAssessmentDto>> createFria(
            @Valid @RequestBody FriaCreateRequestDto request) {

        log.info("Creando evaluación FRIA: projectId={}, deployerUserId={}",
                request.getProjectId(), request.getDeployerUserId());

        Timer.Sample timer = metrics.startClassificationTimer(); // Reutilizar métrica existente

        return friaService.createFria(request)
                .map(response -> {
                    timer.stop(Timer.builder("compliance.fria.create.duration")
                            .description("Tiempo de creación de FRIA")
                            .tag("project_id", String.valueOf(request.getProjectId()))
                            .tag("status", "success")

                    metrics.recordClassificationCreated(request.getProjectId(), "FRIA");

                            .tag("project_id", String.valueOf(request.getProjectId()))
                            .tag("status", "error")
                            .register(metrics.meterRegistry));
                    metrics.recordClassificationError("fria.create", error.getClass().getSimpleName());
                    log.error("Error creando evaluación FRIA: projectId={}", request.getProjectId(), error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PutMapping("/{friaId}/step/{stepNumber}")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Actualizar paso del wizard FRIA",
            description = "Actualiza los datos de un paso específico del wizard FRIA (1-6). " +
                         "Calcula automáticamente el score de completitud."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Paso actualizado exitosamente"
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido o paso inválido"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "FRIA no encontrada")
    })
    @Timed(value = "compliance.fria.update.step", description = "Tiempo de actualización de paso")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Object>> updateStep(
            @PathVariable Long friaId,

            @Valid @RequestBody FriaStepUpdateRequestDto request) {

                .onErrorResume(error -> {

                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());

    @PostMapping("/{friaId}/calculate-risk")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Calcular riesgo final",
            description = "Calcula el riesgo final según Anexo IX del EU AI Act. " +
                         "Fórmula: Risk = (Severity × Probability × Impact) × (1 - Mitigation Effectiveness)"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Riesgo calculado exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = FriaCalculateRiskResponseDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "FRIA no encontrada")
    })
    @Timed(value = "compliance.fria.calculate.risk", description = "Tiempo de cálculo de riesgo")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<FriaCalculateRiskResponseDto>> calculateRisk(
            @PathVariable Long friaId) {

        log.info("Calculando riesgo final: friaId={}", friaId);

        return friaService.calculateRisk(friaId)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error calculando riesgo: friaId={}", friaId, error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{friaId}/notify-authority")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Notificar a autoridades competentes",
            description = "Notifica a autoridades competentes según Art. 27.3 del EU AI Act. " +
                         "Solo disponible si el riesgo final >= 0.75."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Notificación enviada exitosamente"
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "FRIA no completa o riesgo insuficiente"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "FRIA no encontrada")
    })
    @Timed(value = "compliance.fria.notify.authority", description = "Tiempo de notificación a autoridades")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Object>> notifyAuthority(
            @PathVariable Long friaId) {

        log.info("Notificando a autoridades: friaId={}", friaId);

        return friaService.notifyAuthority(friaId)
                .map(response -> {
                    log.info("Notificación enviada: friaId={}, notificationId={}",
                            friaId, response.get("notificationId"));
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error notificando a autoridades: friaId={}", friaId, error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{friaId}/cross-validate")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Validación cruzada con métricas técnicas",
            description = "Compara el FRIA documental con métricas técnicas reales del sistema " +
                         "para detectar inconsistencias (INC-007). Requisito: Score >= 0.70"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Validación cruzada completada"
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "FRIA no encontrada")
    })
    @Timed(value = "compliance.fria.cross.validate", description = "Tiempo de validación cruzada")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Object>> crossValidate(
            @PathVariable Long friaId) {

        log.info("Validación cruzada: friaId={}", friaId);

        return friaService.crossValidate(friaId)
                .map(response -> {
                    log.info("Validación cruzada completada: friaId={}, consistencyScore={}",
                            friaId, response.get("consistencyScore"));
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error en validación cruzada: friaId={}", friaId, error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{friaId}")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Obtener detalle de FRIA",
            description = "Obtiene el detalle completo de una evaluación FRIA, " +
                         "agregando datos de múltiples microservicios."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "FRIA encontrada",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = FriaAssessmentDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "FRIA no encontrada")

Corrigiendo los errores de tipo: los métodos que retornan `Mono<ResponseEntity<Object>>` reciben `Mono<ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>>>`. Ajustando los tipos de retorno:

package com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.controller;

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
